name: Youtube video downloader
author: Bibek Bhusal
description: Download videos and playlists from YouTube and other sites via yt-dlp with up to three parallel downloads, a queue, and a persistent history.

barWidget.description: Video and playlist downloader with parallel downloads, a queue, and a persistent history.

schema.label: Default download type
schema.description: What to download by default: video only, audio only, or both.

schema.label: Transcript languages
schema.description: Comma-separated language codes for transcripts (e.g., 'en,es,fr'). Use 'all' for all available.

schema.label: Playlist in separate folder
schema.description: Download playlists into their own subfolder named after the playlist.

schema.label: Cookies from browser
schema.description: Browser to pull cookies from to bypass YouTube bot detection. Use 'none' if you have no issues.

schema.label: Extra yt-dlp args
schema.description: Extra arguments passed to every yt-dlp invocation, e.g. '--cookies-from-browser chromium' or '--socket-timeout 30'.

schema.label: Enable download history
schema.description: Keep finished downloads in a history list with play, retry and remove actions.
